options_evaluated: Bio-based Polylactic Acid (PLA) reinforced with flax fibers
decisions.trade_off: Balancing mechanical durability and drop-resistance (to prevent premature physical failure) against the carbon footprint of raw material extraction and end-of-life recyclability.
decisions.rationale: Recycled ABS significantly lowers the embodied carbon compared to virgin PC/ABS while maintaining sufficient impact strength and stiffness required for a hand tool housing. Unlike fiber-reinforced bio-plastics, it can be easily integrated into existing municipal recycling streams at the product's end-of-life.
decisions.design_action: Verify the availability and consistency of local post-consumer recycled ABS supply chains and check compliance with RoHS/REACH regulations for recycled feedstocks.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal inserts with machine screws
decisions.trade_off: Ease of automated high-speed manufacturing and weight reduction versus non-destructive disassembly for repair, component upgrading, and clean material separation during recycling.
decisions.recommendation: Threaded metal inserts with machine screws
decisions.rationale: While ultrasonic welding is fast and lightweight, it permanently seals the housing, preventing battery or motor replacement. Threaded fasteners allow infinite disassembly and reassembly cycles without stripping the plastic housing, maximizing the product's useful lifespan and facilitating easy battery replacement.
decisions.design_action: Investigate standard fastener sizes across the tool assembly to minimize tool-type requirements for disassembly and check compatibility with standard consumer repair tools.

decisions.trade_off: Lower initial environmental impact and cost of raw materials (brushed motors use fewer rare-earth magnets) versus long-term operational efficiency, energy conservation, and product lifespan.
decisions.rationale: BLDC motors eliminate carbon brush wear, which is the primary failure point of brushed motors, thereby extending the tool's operational lifetime by up to 2-3x. Their higher energy efficiency also reduces battery drain per screw cycle, extending the overall battery cycle life.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability of brushless motor suppliers that offer modular, easily separable rotor and stator assemblies to facilitate end-of-life rare-earth magnet recovery.

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via integrated aluminum heat sinks
Passive cooling via housing ventilation slots and optimized copper PCB traces
decisions.trade_off: Active cooling increases parasitic power draw and introduces dust/moisture ingress risks but reduces peak temperatures, whereas passive cooling is highly reliable but requires more material mass or careful housing design.
decisions.recommendation: Passive cooling via housing ventilation slots and optimized copper PCB traces
decisions.rationale: Eliminating an active fan reduces mechanical complexity, parasitic power loss, and dust ingress, which protects internal electronics from premature failure. It avoids the high embodied carbon of large aluminum heat sinks by utilizing the existing PCB and natural airflow.
decisions.design_action: Check historical failure data of similar hand tools to verify if passive convective cooling is sufficient for typical DIY duty cycles without causing thermal degradation of the battery cells.

options_evaluated: Modular cartridge system (separate battery, switch, and motor modules)
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections
decisions.trade_off: Monobloc design minimizes material use and weight but forces complete product disposal upon single-component failure; modular cartridges increase material overhead but allow rapid, tool-less component replacement.
decisions.recommendation: Modular cartridge system (separate battery, switch, and motor modules)
decisions.rationale: The battery and trigger switch are the most common failure points in cordless tools. A modular cartridge system allows users to replace just the degraded battery pack or worn switch without replacing the motor or housing, drastically extending the product's useful life.
decisions.design_action: Investigate industry-standard modular battery interfaces and check the feasibility of a standardized connector system that avoids proprietary lock-ins.

decisions.trade_off: Integrated cells allow for a highly compact and lightweight design but render the tool useless once the battery degrades; removable packs increase weight and volume but allow battery swapping and proper recycling.
decisions.rationale: Cylindrical Li-ion cells (e.g., 18650 or 21700) are highly standardized, reliable, and widely recycled. Making the pack removable ensures the tool's lifespan is not limited by chemical battery degradation and allows the battery to be shared with other tools in a platform.
decisions.design_action: Investigate existing open-share battery platform standards or compatibility guidelines to determine if the battery pack can interface with existing charger ecosystems.
